articles.title: Inside SKVLK Fest 2026: Anelise's 18th Birthday Bash Was the Party of the Year
articles.dek: Carnival rides, a stacked lineup and a VIP creator lounge: Jamie Foxx and his daughter Anelise threw Thousand Oaks a night to remember. And the stabbing story? The festival's team says it never happened. Were you there?

articles.title: Richard T. Jones Hosts Hollywood's Most Global Red Carpet Tonight
articles.dek: DeVon Franklin, Oscar winner Nick Vallelonga and Grammy-nominated producer Theron “Neff-U” Feemster lead filmmakers from 30 nations into the Writers Guild Theater for the 2026 Global Film Awards. Who are you hoping to see on the carpet?

articles.title: Hollywood Celebrates the Blue Wave
articles.dek: From Jimmy Kimmel's late-night victory lap to John Leguizamo's “this is redemption time,” the stars came out for the Democrats' midterm sweep, and the history-makers gave them plenty to cheer.

articles.title: Ramayana Takes Over the Academy Museum
articles.dek: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi brought Indian cinema's most anticipated epic to a Los Angeles red carpet on Tuesday night, and the fans outside chanted for the villain.

articles.title: Freda Payne Stole VMAs Weekend
articles.dek: Every camera in town was pointed at the Peacock Theater. But the night Hollywood can't stop raving about happened on Sunset, where an 84-year-old legend in gold lamé delivered a sold-out, standing-ovation, once-in-a-lifetime triumph.
